summary: Once the delegate business is settled, a member offers something written for the people in the room.
realLife: Rose Andrews, the county committeewoman, read a poem she had written for the 21st District caucus when the chair opened general closing remarks.
inGame: needs: completed business and time for members to speak.

turns.pulledBy: The chair has time for closing contributions.
turns.what: The member reads the piece prepared for the occasion.
turns.writesBack: The meeting ends with something beyond its ballots.

turns.what: The member offers to share the piece afterward.
turns.writesBack: The vote can stand even though the reading is deferred.
